Docket 1.3.105

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *The outbound link check is faster.* Docket checks a sample of the links your pages
  send to other sites. It asked those sites one at a time, at the same pace it uses
  on your own site, so 60 links to 60 different servers took as long as 60 requests
  to yours. Each other site now has its own clock: the same pause between requests to
  that one host, and different hosts are asked side by side. On a test site linking to
  30 servers the link stage went from 15.6 seconds to 1.4, with the same 60 links
  checked and the same dead link reported. Your own site is still asked at its own
  pace, including any Crawl-delay in your robots.txt. A link the time limit stopped
  before it was asked is left out of the result and no longer counts as unreachable.

99 checks across 13 areas.
